<set-variable name="chargebackMicroUsd" value="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("chargebackMicroUsd", context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("costMicroUsd", 0)))" />
<set-variable name="chargebackPayer" value="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("payer", context.Subscription?.Id ?? "anonymous"))" />
<set-variable name="chargebackItem" value="@{ var surface = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("surface", ""); return surface == "tool" ? context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("toolName", "") : surface == "agent" ? context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("agentId", "") : context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("servedModel", ""); }" />
@("Chargeback: " + (string)context.Variables["chargebackPayer"] + " session " + context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("session", "no-session") + " " + context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("surface", "") + " " + (string)context.Variables["chargebackItem"] + " " + (int)context.Variables["chargebackMicroUsd"] + " micro-USD")
<metadata name="session" value="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("session", "no-session"))" /> <metadata name="surface" value="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("surface", ""))" />
<metadata name="chargedMicroUsd" value="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("costMicroUsd", 0).ToString())" /> <metadata name="promptTokens" value="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("promptTokens", 0).ToString())" /> <metadata name="completionTokens" value="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("completionTokens", 0).ToString())" /> <metadata name="tier" value="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("payerTier", context.Product?.Id ?? "none"))" /> <metadata name="via" value="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("via", "direct"))" /> <metadata name="caller" value="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("caller", "unknown"))" />
